# encapi_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role and its inheritable default params.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "encapi_role" "vault" {
  name = "roles::infra::storage::vault"
}

output "vault_default_params" {
  value = jsondecode(data.encapi_role.vault.default_params)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role/class name.

### Read-Only

- `default_params` (String) Default params as JSON.
- `description` (String) Description.
